name: Pseudo-marginal Metropolis Light Transport (PSSMLT)
definition: A Monte Carlo method that uses an unbiased estimator of the light path contribution function instead of the exact value within a Metropolis-Hastings framework, allowing for efficient exploration of path space in heterogeneous media.
summary: PSSMLT is a Monte Carlo method for rendering in heterogeneous media that uses unbiased estimators and ratio tracking to ensure exact path density sampling.
